svg.title: homebrew-tap
svg.desc: homebrew-tap: Homebrew formulae for Swara, a LilyPond language server and Neovim plugin MIT, Shell, 3 commits. The panel shows brew install anirbanchakraborty-dev/tap/swara, the formula's version 0.1.1, its 4 prebuilt targets, macOS arm64, macOS x86_64, Linux arm64, Linux x86_64, and the commands brew test runs: swara --version, swara info.

g.text: Homebrew formulae for Swara, a LilyPond language
LilyPond language server, formatter and Tree-sitter grammar
